description: This file contains functions and logic for generating a DATEV format report and CSV download for accounting data, including validation, data retrieval, and packaging into a ZIP file.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point for generating the report; validates filters and retrieves transaction data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks for mandatory filters and correct fiscal year range.

methods.name: validate_fiscal_year
methods.description: Ensures from_date and to_date are within the same fiscal year.

methods.name: get_transactions
methods.description: Retrieves transaction data based on filters, with support for specific voucher types.

methods.name: get_payment_entry_params
methods.description: Defines additional query parameters for Payment Entry vouchers.

methods.name: get_sales_invoice_params
methods.description: Defines additional query parameters for Sales Invoice vouchers.

methods.name: get_purchase_invoice_params
methods.description: Defines additional query parameters for Purchase Invoice vouchers.

methods.name: get_generic_params
methods.description: Defines query parameters for other voucher types.

methods.name: run_query
methods.description: Executes the SQL query to fetch GL entries with optional extra joins and filters.

methods.name: get_customers
methods.description: Fetches customer data for DATEV export.

methods.name: get_suppliers
methods.description: Fetches supplier data for DATEV export.

methods.name: get_account_names
methods.description: Retrieves account number and label mappings.

methods.name: download_datev_csv
methods.description: Validates filters, gathers data, creates CSV files, and packages them into a ZIP for download.
